paragraphs: MJM Innovations sells software products and outsourced management services for transportation and aging services programs, described on its home page as Electronic Transaction Management. The home page states that these products and services improve efficiencies for government and corporate programs, transportation providers, aging services and senior centers.

Products named on the home page include EzTransport for automating fare and data collection on a transportation program, and TaxiCard, a payment system built from a swipe card, a processing platform and web-based software. SENIORSTAT is offered for AAAs, Senior Centers, Congregate meal Sites and Home Care Services.

The case studies page lists work for Maryland Transit Administration, Montgomery County, Capital Area Rural Transportation System, Los Angeles Department of Transportation, and Lincoln Aging Partners. One entry describes voucher programs for the elderly and disabled handled with TaxiCard fare collection technology. Another entry pairs SENIORSTAT senior center management software with card technology for Lincoln Aging Partners.

quote.text: We offer a wide range of technologies from transportation, senior & aging services, and other programs with transaction tracking software.
